attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to gain persistence or move laterally over the network by executing code on remote hosts using scheduled tasks. The ITaskSchedulerService RPC interface is used to create and manage scheduled tasks on a local or remote host.
description: The endpoint performed abnormal Scheduled Task RPC activity to a remote host.
detector_tags: NDR Lateral Movement Analytics, NDR Unmanaged Subnet Analytics
investigative_actions: Review the action of the created scheduled task on the remote host. Correlate the RPC call from the source host and understand which software initiated it. Verify that this isn't IT activity.
name: Rare Scheduled Task RPC activity from a rarely seen host
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
